plain_language:
1. When the robot arrives at the user, it must announce the delivery via speech within 1.0 seconds.  
2. After the robot announces the delivery, the user must acknowledge the delivery (via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds.  
3. Once the user acknowledges the delivery, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
ig_syntax:
robot_arrives_at_user → robot_announce_delivery @within(1.0s)
robot_announce_delivery → user_acknowledge_delivery @within(8s)
user_acknowledge_delivery → robot_final_confirmation @within(1s)

provenance.source_text: The robot should announce the delivery via speech. → User clarified: 1.0 seconds
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
